BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the designation of the state stone; and adding a new section to chapter 1.20 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: The Wilkeson Sandstone is hereby designated as the official stone of the state of Washington.
